name: 連絡先から場所を探す案内
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create ONE Lighthouse component LH01-0004 連絡先から場所を探す案内.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: input1 ORIGINAL source controls icon glyph geometry, optical weight, proportions, alignment and fine details. Use the contacts invitation at source region x39 y951 width1105 height343. Input2 is a rough Japanese mock, secondary ONLY for localized Japanese text/overall layout; its thin rectangular contact-icon substitute is inaccurate. Input3 approved bus direction is STYLE ONLY.
Preserve original contact/address-book icon anatomy: a compact slate filled rounded rectangular book/body, white simple person silhouette inside, short horizontal tabs/lines above and below, matching original source optical balance, no invented outline badge. Place it at the left of the text column.
Exact Japanese text: title "知り合いの場所を探す"; supporting sentence "連絡先を追加すると、保存した住所から探せます。"; action "連絡先を追加". Keep that complete sentence with natural wrapping, no ellipsis. One title, one sentence, one action, nothing else.
Accent decision: original uses blue for the actual Add contacts primary action and gray contact icon. Adapt the real action consistently to Lighthouse forest-green gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E with white label and restrained edge light/shadow, as approved style. Keep utility contact icon slate #526173; do not tint each icon. No blue primary CTA or broad mint fill.
Compact rounded white card on pure-white #FFFFFF canvas, fine neutral border and soft downward elevation, title/body/action aligned in one text column beside icon, generous enough touch target for the single action, no unnecessary height. Typography: preserve Japanese Meiryo Regular14/24 title and action, Regular12/16 supporting copy, tracking0, no all-bold text. Main #1D1D1D, supporting #6E6E6E. Landscape around2:1, flat frontal UI, modest white margins. No search field/results/keyboard, extra text/features, device chrome or logos.
reviewNotes: 原参照を優先し連絡帳の塗りつぶし本体・白い人物・上下の短線を復元。モックの粗い輪郭代替図形を不採用。原の青い主要導線を正式な森林緑グラデーションへ適用、補助図形はスレート。タイトル、説明全文、連絡先を追加の1操作、白カードと欠けなしを視認。静止画像エージェントレビューのみ、所有者承認・正確なフォント一致・編集可能性・実装は未証明。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
